Real Madrid star Yan Diomandé has emerged as, statistically, the most prolific dribbler in the Spanish top-flight across the season to date.

Winger Diomandé is for his part fresh off another starring performance in the colours of Real Madrid this past weekend. En route to a 3-0 victory over Racing Santander, the Ivorian notched a wonderful goal, amid a fine all-round performance.

Also on full show at the Campos de Sport were Diomandé’s dribbling skills, as the 19-year-old continues to light up Spanish football since his summer arrival from RB Leipzig.

Diomandé has spent recent weeks showcasing precisely why Real Madrid pushed so hard for his signature over the summer, with all of his touch, ability to beat his man, vision, final ball and long-distance shooting of the highest standard.

And as alluded to above, early this week, one particular statistic has aptly highlighted the attacker’s stellar current level in one specific area.

As per statistician Jorge C Picon:

Players who complete the most dribbles per 90 minutes in LaLiga:

  • Yan Diomandé (4.27)
  • Yeremay Hernández (4.03)
  • Lamine Yamal (4.00)

Conor Laird – GSFN
